Degree mode: A response that presents answers obtained by using a calculator in degree mode does 
not earn the first point it would have otherwise earned. The response is generally eligible for all 
subsequent points (unless no answer is possible in degree mode or the question is made simpler by 
using degree mode). In degree mode,
